records.context: Classify's annotation mode reads its labels from ``png_list`` only, joined by ``prcfo``, so a label that stays on the annotated table never reaches it. Each output column is added to ``png_list`` the way Annotate adds its own and filled for the objects of ``frame``; a row whose label was cleared is set to NULL, and objects outside ``frame`` are left as they are. A receipt with the recipe is stored beside the labels, so the source reopens with its annotation columns.

records.source: Classify's annotation mode reads its labels from ``png_list`` only, joined by ``prcfo``, so a label that stays on the annotated table never reaches it. Each output column is added to ``png_list`` the way Annotate adds its own and filled for the objects of ``frame``; a row whose label was cleared is set to NULL, and objects outside ``frame`` are left as they are. A receipt with the recipe is stored beside the labels, so the source reopens with its annotation columns.
records.translation: Classify의 어노테이션 모드는 ``png_list``에서만 레이블을 읽고 ``prcfo``로 결합하므로, 어노테이션된 테이블에만 남아 있는 레이블은 그곳에 전달되지 않습니다. 각 출력 열은 Annotate가 자체 열을 추가하는 방식대로 ``png_list``에 추가되고 ``frame``의 객체에 대해 값이 채워집니다. 레이블이 지워진 행은 NULL로 설정되며, ``frame``에 없는 객체는 그대로 둡니다. 레시피가 담긴 기록이 레이블과 함께 저장되므로, 원본을 다시 열면 어노테이션 열도 함께 열립니다.
